title: Plate with two slots

description.en: A plate 100 x 40 x 5 mm (corner at the origin, along +X, +Y, +Z) with two through slots for adjusting a mounting: each slot is 20 mm long end to end and 6 mm wide with round ends, runs along X on the plate's centre line (Y = 20), and is centred 30 mm from its end of the plate (the left slot at X = 30, the right one at X = length - 30). Drive the plate by the variables length, width and thickness; when the plate gets longer the right slot stays 30 mm from the right end.
description.nl: Een plaat van 100 x 40 x 5 mm (hoek in de oorsprong, langs +X, +Y, +Z) met twee doorgaande sleuven om een bevestiging te verstellen: elke sleuf is 20 mm lang van eind tot eind en 6 mm breed met ronde uiteinden, loopt langs X op de middellijn van de plaat (Y = 20) en ligt met zijn midden 30 mm van zijn eind van de plaat (de linker op X = 30, de rechter op X = length - 30). Stuur de plaat met de variabelen length, width en thickness; als de plaat langer wordt, blijft de rechter sleuf 30 mm van het rechter eind.

expect.value: (length * width - 2 * (14 mm * 6 mm + pi * (3 mm)^2)) * thickness
2 * (length * width - 2 * (14 mm * 6 mm + pi * (3 mm)^2)) + 2 * (length + width) * thickness + 2 * (2 * 14 mm + pi * 6 mm) * thickness

derivation: A slot of length s and width w with round ends is a rectangle (s - w) x w and two half discs, one disc of diameter w: A = 14*6 + pi*3^2 = 112.27 mm^2. Its perimeter is 2 (s - w) + pi w.
Area: top and bottom less two slots each, the four sides, and both slot walls (perimeter times t).
The slots are centred at X = 30 and X = L - 30, symmetric about X = L/2, and on Y = 20, which is the centre line while the width is 40; the centroid is (L/2, 20, t/2).
The reference makes the left slot from a sketch and the right one from a block and two cylinders whose positions follow length; both ways are fine.
